title: How to Boost Your Portfolio with Top Computer and Technology Stocks Set to Beat Earnings
author: Zacks.Com
description: The article explains how investors can use the Zacks Earnings ESP (Expected Surprise Prediction) filter to identify stocks likely to beat earnings estimates. It highlights that positive ESP combined with strong Zacks Rank ratings has historically produced 28% annual returns. Two tech stocks are featured as examples: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) with a #2 Buy rating and +0.56% ESP ahead of October 26 earnings, and Adobe Systems (ADBE) with a #3 Hold rating and +0.08% ESP before December 9 earnings.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Holds a #2 Buy rating with a positive ESP of +0.56%, indicating higher probability of beating earnings expectations on October 26, 2026. The positive ESP combined with strong Zacks Rank suggests potential for outperformance.

Holds a #3 Hold rating with a positive ESP of +0.08%, suggesting a modest probability of beating earnings expectations on December 9, 2026. While the ESP is smaller than CDNS, it still indicates potential for a positive earnings surprise.

title: ASUS ProArt RTX Spark Windows PCs Available for Immediate Pre-Order Today, Delivering Integrated Ecosystem of AI Agents and Creative Apps
author: Asus
description: ASUS announced the launch of ProArt P16 and P14 laptops powered by NVIDIA's RTX Spark Superchip, featuring up to 128GB unified memory and 1 petaflop AI performance. The systems are designed for creators and AI developers, offering local AI processing without cloud dependency. Pre-orders began October 7, 2026, with prices starting at $2,599.99. ASUS partnered with ComfyUI and Nous Research's Hermes Agent to provide an integrated AI workflow ecosystem.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: NVIDIA's RTX Spark Superchip is the core technology enabling these new laptops, demonstrating strong demand for its AI accelerators in consumer devices. The partnership highlights NVIDIA's expanding presence in the creator and AI developer markets beyond data centers.

Adobe Creative Cloud is mentioned as an available bundle with ProArt laptops, providing cloud-based creative services alongside local AI tools. This represents a complementary offering rather than a primary focus of the announcement.

title: Salesforce Stock Falls 15% YTD: Should Investors Keep Holding CRM?
author: Na
description: Salesforce (CRM) has declined 15.1% YTD amid broader software sector weakness, but underlying fundamentals show stabilization with 10.8% revenue growth and strong cRPO growth of 14%. Agentforce ARR surpassed $1.5 billion with 240% YoY growth, positioning the company as an AI-driven growth engine. Trading below sector average P/E of 13.94x, the stock presents a reasonable risk-reward for existing shareholders, though new investors should await clearer evidence of sustained AI-driven growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed signals: negative YTD performance (-15.1%) and AI disruption concerns offset by stabilizing revenue growth (10.8%), strong cRPO growth (14%), explosive Agentforce ARR growth (240% YoY), and attractive valuation (13.94x forward P/E below sector average). Hold rating reflects balanced risk-reward.
Mentioned as underperforming with -32.1% YTD decline, indicating broader software sector weakness and investor concerns about AI disruption to traditional SaaS models.
Declined 13.3% YTD as part of broader software sector selloff driven by AI concerns and macroeconomic headwinds affecting enterprise software spending.

title: Why Adobe Systems (ADBE) is a Top Growth Stock for the Long-Term
author: Na
description: Zacks Premium offers investment research tools including Style Scores (Value, Growth, Momentum, and VGM) that complement the Zacks Rank system to help investors identify stocks with the best performance potential. The article highlights Adobe Systems as a stock to watch with a #3 Hold rank and Grade A VGM and Growth scores, forecasting 16.9% year-over-year earnings growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Adobe received a positive mention as a 'Stock to Watch' with strong fundamentals including a Grade A VGM Score, Grade A Growth Style Score, forecasted 16.9% year-over-year earnings growth, and upward earnings estimate revisions from 15 analysts in the last 60 days. The article suggests it should be on investors' short lists despite its #3 Hold rank.
